title: Row-minor ideal of an arbitrary submodule of a finite free module
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $n,k\ge0$, and let $K\subseteq R^{\oplus n}$ be any $R$-submodule [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Define the row-minor ideal $D_k(K;n)\subseteq R$ to be $R$ if $n\le k$. If $k<n$, it is the ideal generated by the determinants [def-weil-pbc-matrix-determinant] of all $(n-k)\times(n-k)$ submatrices [def-weil-submatrix] of all $(n-k)\times n$ matrices [def-weil-matrix] with rows in $K$. Equivalently, in this latter case it is the sum of the minor ideals $J_{n-k}(B)$ [def-trf-minor-ideal] over all such $(n-k)\times n$ matrices $B$ with rows in $K$. No finite generation of $K$ is assumed.
